fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-01-14 states that the complainant found that the shop shutter near Palar Park Industrial Area had been damaged overnight, causing a loss of roughly Rs. 90,000, on 2026-01-11 at roughly 01:25. Arun Prakash submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000194. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Vasanthi Bai, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000115, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property allegedly damaged following a local dispute.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, night, photograph, CCTV, suspect, industrial area, mobile number
